title: Step
description: A single entry in a testcase's or scenario's step sequence: a template-step (client + template + dataset, optionally asserted) or a call into a reusable scenario (scenario + optional dataset). Referenced from suite.schema.json and scenario.schema.json.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the step, shown in results. Defaults to "<client>: <template>" if omitted.

client.description: Name of the registered client that sends the rendered template. Must match a client registered in the Maestro client registry at runtime, and must be listed in the template's own 'clients'.

template.description: File path of a reusable template, or an inline template body, whose placeholders are filled in with 'dataset' and sent via 'client'.

dataset.description: Values used to fill in the template's placeholders. Either an inline dataset body (see dataset.schema.json 'data' for a single bag of values, 'rows' for a table), or a string giving the file path of a separately-defined dataset. If the resolved dataset has 'rows' rather than 'data', this step is executed once per row, with each row's fields available for interpolation, producing one StepResult per row.

assert.description: Optional checks run against this step's result after it executes (once per row, if 'dataset' iterates). Each check is dispatched to a registered assertion matcher.

save.description: Optional values to extract from this step's response into named state, for later steps to reference via interpolation.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this scenario call, shown in results. Defaults to the scenario name if omitted.

scenario.description: File path of a reusable scenario to run at this point, or an inline scenario body.

dataset.description: Input values passed to the scenario's parameters. Either an inline dataset body, or a string giving the file path of a separately-defined dataset. If the resolved dataset has 'rows' rather than 'data', this scenario call is executed once per row, with each row's fields available for interpolation, producing one StepResult per row.

path.description: Path into this step's response identifying the value to extract (e.g. "$.token").

as.description: Name to store the extracted value under, referenceable in later steps via interpolation (e.g. "{{auth_token}}").

examples.name: create account for each seeded user
